title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android: call quality feedback surveys after meetings
summary: The rollout, licensing and survey-control guidance are supported. However, the briefing overstates the absence of published retention information: Microsoft documents these results in Call Quality Dashboard, whose documentation gives retention periods, including for feedback text. Narrow the privacy caveat to what the notice omits rather than saying retention information is unpublished.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: Microsoft has not published how long survey data is kept, so no retention review can be completed from published information.
claims.quote: For compliance reasons, EUII data (also known as personally-identifiable information or PII) is only kept for 28 days. As CQD's data crosses the 28-day mark, fields that contain EUII are cleared, resulting in EUII-free data.
claims.fix: Replace the broad retention-absence statements in Why it matters, Risk assessment and Before rollout with: 'MC1490912 does not specify survey-response retention or storage duration.' Remove 'a retention or residency review cannot be completed from published information'. Do not imply that no retention information exists: https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/rooms/rooms-release-note says these survey results are visible in CQD; https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/cqd-data-and-reports documents 12-month CQD call-record retention and clearing EUII, explicitly including Feedback Text, after 28 days. This does not establish retention of every copy of a raw survey response.
